name: Greiner 655161 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Greiner Bio-One 96 well microplate, PS, F-bottom standard, clear, sterile, no lid. This is the standard solid-bottom mould, NOT the chimney-well design used by the CELLSTAR 655090, and it is not TC-treated. Dimensions from Greiner customer drawing rev 1 (2025-06-10), '96 Well Microplate, PS, F-Bottom without lid', valid for 655101/655161/655191, cross-checked against product data sheet PDS 6551xx rev 09 and the Greiner Microplate Dimensions Guide (F073027). Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm, plate height 14.6 mm, flange/skirt height 2.5 mm. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm. A1 well center is 14.38 mm from the left edge and 11.24 mm from the top edge. Well top diameter 6.96 mm, bottom diameter 6.39 mm, depth 10.9 mm, flat solid bottom. Total well volume 382 uL, working volume 25-340 uL. Well bottom thickness is not published for this part. Greiner publishes no ANSI/SBS compliance claim for 655161, though the footprint matches the standard. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
